0d0d0515f867eafb1711116c.title: LEAPS “LOCAL ENVIRONMENT ALLIANCE” PROJECT SERIES
0d0d0515f867eafb1711116c.location: Unknown from the image; no physical capture location is given.
paragraphs: Location: The poster refers to Hong Kong and the local Pearl River Delta region in its text, but it does not show a room or establish where the poster image was captured.

Objects and counts: This is a dense text-and-diagram poster, not a room photograph. It contains two main subproject sections, a plasmid-style circular diagram, process illustrations, a comparison table, reactor schematics, and small biological imagery. The upper band includes HKU and iGEM marks. The bottom includes social and email icons.

Visible text: The header reads HKU IGEM 2023; the main title is LEAPS and "LOCAL ENVIRONMENT ALLIANCE" PROJECT SERIES. The sections read # INTRODUCTION, # FINISHED SUBPROJECT: AMPed, and # UPCOMING SUBPROJECT: B-MAT SYSTEM. The introduction states the project series has two subprojects and continues work on a B-MAT system. The AMPed copy mentions antimicrobial resistance, CecB, and Chlorella vulgaris. The B-MAT text discusses battery recycling and bioleaching. The comparison table headings include method comparison, hydrometallurgy pyrometallurgy, traditional bioleaching, and B-MAT bioleaching; rows include energy/cost, time, ecology effect, and recovery rate (mainly lithium). Footer text reads @HKU.IGEM and IGEMHKU@HKU.HK. Many paragraphs are too small for dependable full transcription.

Spatial relationships: A cream header strip runs across the top. The dark-green body begins with the large LEAPS title and introduction. The completed AMPed project occupies the upper-middle with diagrams to the left and explanatory copy to the right. The upcoming B-MAT section fills the lower half, with prose at left and comparison table and process figures at right. A cream footer strip spans the bottom.

Distinctive colours and materials: The poster uses a deep green background, cream panels and lettering, and dark green body copy. Diagrams use muted red, gray, and green. It is a graphic poster; physical materials are not applicable.
uncertainties: Dense paragraph text and small table entries are only partly legible in the preview; no unreadable wording has been reconstructed.
Printed year “2023” is visible but is not a capture date.
